query: Where is CityPark Central located?
reference_answer: CityPark Central is located at 123 Central Avenue, Downtown, City DC 10001. It is a 2-minute walk from Central Station (Lines 2, 4, 6).

query: How do I get to CityPark Eastside by public transport?
reference_answer: Take Line 7 to Eastside Tech Station; CityPark Eastside is a 5-minute walk east along Eastside Boulevard.

query: What is the address of the airport parking facility?
reference_answer: CityPark Airport is at 1 Airport Connector Road, Transit Zone, City DC 10088. A free shuttle runs every 15 minutes to the terminal.

query: Which bus routes stop near CityPark Central?
reference_answer: Routes 12, 14, and 27 stop directly outside the CityPark Central entrance on Central Avenue.

query: Is there a shuttle from CityPark Airport to the terminal?
reference_answer: Yes, a free shuttle runs every 15 minutes between CityPark Airport and the Airport Connector Terminal Arrivals Level Bay 7.

query: What is the speed limit inside the parking facility?
reference_answer: The maximum speed inside all CityPark facilities is 10 mph (16 km/h).

query: Can I do car repairs inside the parking lot?
reference_answer: No, running repairs, oil changes, or mechanical work on site are strictly prohibited.

query: What happens if I park in a driving aisle?
reference_answer: Vehicles blocking aisles or exits will be wheel-clamped (fee: $75) and may be towed at the owner's expense.

query: What is the maximum vehicle size allowed?
reference_answer: Standard bays accommodate vehicles up to 5.0 m long, 2.2 m wide, and 2.0 m tall.

query: Is smoking allowed in the covered parking areas?
reference_answer: No, smoking and vaping are prohibited inside any covered structure at CityPark facilities.

query: How do I make a parking reservation through the chatbot?
reference_answer: Tell the assistant you'd like a reservation, then provide your full name, vehicle plate, preferred facility, arrival time, and departure time. Confirm the summary to finalise.

query: What format is the booking reference number?
reference_answer: Booking references follow the format CPK-YYYYMMDD-XXXX (e.g. CPK-20261030-0047).

query: How do I check in at the barrier when I arrive?
reference_answer: Scan your QR code or enter your booking reference on the keypad at the barrier; it will raise automatically.

query: Can I extend my booking while already parked?
reference_answer: Yes, you can extend via the CityPark app, the chatbot, or in-facility pay stations, subject to availability.

query: Does CityPark accept Apple Pay?
reference_answer: Yes, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay are all accepted at all physical payment terminals.

query: Can I pay with cash at the airport parking?
reference_answer: No, CityPark Airport is cashless; please use a card or digital wallet.

query: What discount do pre-paid account holders receive?
reference_answer: CityPark pre-paid account holders receive a 5% discount on all bookings and 10% off EV charging sessions.

query: How much does it cost to overstay my booking?
reference_answer: Overstay is charged at the standard hourly rate for that facility, rounded up to the nearest 30 minutes.

query: What type of EV chargers are available at CityPark Central?
reference_answer: CityPark Central has 12 Type 2 AC bays (22 kW) and 4 CCS DC fast-charge bays (50 kW) on Levels 1 and 2.

query: How much does EV charging cost per kWh?
reference_answer: AC charging (Type 2) costs $0.35/kWh and DC fast charging (CCS) costs $0.55/kWh, in addition to the standard parking fee.

query: Do I need to book an EV charging bay in advance?
reference_answer: EV bays can be reserved in advance by selecting 'EV Charging Bay' when booking; walk-in access is subject to availability but not guaranteed.

query: Is Tesla charging available at CityPark?
reference_answer: Tesla vehicles can use the Type 2 chargers with a CCS adapter; CHAdeMO adapters are not provided on site.

query: How many EV charging bays are at CityPark Airport?
reference_answer: CityPark Airport has 18 Type 2 AC bays (22 kW) and 6 CCS DC fast-charge bays (50 kW) near the shuttle stop.

query: Are there accessible parking spaces available?
reference_answer: Yes, accessible bays are available at all three facilities at no extra charge; a valid Blue Badge must be displayed.

query: How wide are the accessible parking bays?
reference_answer: Accessible bays are 3.8 m wide by 5.5 m long to accommodate ramps and transfer space.

query: Is there step-free access throughout the facilities?
reference_answer: Yes, all CityPark facilities are fully step-free; CityPark Central and Airport also have lifts with audio floor announcements.

query: How can I request assistance if I have a disability?
reference_answer: Press the blue intercom button on any emergency pillar, call the accessibility helpline at +1 (555) 200-7050, or inform the chatbot at booking time.

query: Can I cancel my booking for free?
reference_answer: Yes, reservations cancelled more than 2 hours before the start time receive a full refund.

query: What is the cancellation fee if I cancel last minute?
reference_answer: Cancellations between 2 hours and 30 minutes before the start time incur a 50% fee; the remaining 50% is refunded.

query: What happens if I do not show up for my reservation?
reference_answer: No-shows (not arriving within 30 minutes of the booked start time) receive no refund.

query: Will I get a refund if CityPark closes due to bad weather?
reference_answer: Yes, if CityPark must close due to force majeure (severe weather, power outage, etc.), all affected reservations are fully refunded.

query: Is there CCTV inside the parking facility?
reference_answer: Yes, all areas including aisles, stairwells, and exits are covered by HD CCTV operating 24/7 with 30-day footage retention.

query: What should I do in case of fire?
reference_answer: Activate the nearest red break-glass alarm, evacuate via green exit signs, do not use elevators, and go to the designated assembly point.

query: Are there on-site security staff?
reference_answer: CityPark Central and Eastside are staffed during operating hours with patrols every 30 minutes; CityPark Airport is staffed 24 hours a day.

query: How do I report damage to my vehicle?
reference_answer: Report vehicle damage to on-site staff immediately, or email security@citypark.example.com with your booking reference and details.

query: Do you have a loyalty programme?
reference_answer: Yes, every dollar spent earns 1 CityPark Point; 200 points equal $10 credit. Points expire after 12 months of inactivity.

query: Can I book parking for someone else?
reference_answer: Yes, provide the driver's name and their vehicle plate when booking; the confirmation can be shared with the driver.

query: What if my QR code does not scan at the barrier?
reference_answer: Enter your booking reference manually on the barrier keypad (format: CPK-YYYYMMDD-XXXX); if that fails, press the intercom for staff help.

query: Hello, how are you today?
reference_answer: Hello! I'm the CityPark assistant and I'm ready to help you with parking availability, prices, directions, or reservations.

query: Can you recommend a good restaurant near the parking lot?
reference_answer: I can only assist with parking-related questions; for restaurant recommendations please use a general search engine.
